alt: 年輕學徒展示精巧的木鳥，年長師傅看著出色的作品，露出敬佩的笑容。
scene_prompt: At a woodworking workshop a talented young apprentice presents an exceptionally intricate smoothly finished wooden bird with moving articulated wings. An elderly experienced craftsperson holding their own simpler wooden bird looks at the young person’s superior work with admiring delight, one open hand warmly praising it. The apprentice stands respectfully modest. Emphasize a younger generation’s remarkable achievement earning elder respect, never an elder afraid of a child.
